inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE TEXT (pdfimages: zero raster images; VLM confirmed): the intro line 'Cancer is caused by (mostly acquired) DNA mutations that affect fundamental cellular processes (eg, growth, DNA repair, survival)' plus the complete 9-row table — growth signal self-sufficiency (proto-oncogenes/↑PDGF brain tumors, HER2 breast, RAS, MYC, cyclins/CDKs), anti-growth signal insensitivity (Rb; E-cadherin loss → contact inhibition, NF2), evasion of apoptosis (TP53, BCL2 → follicular B cell lymphoma), limitless replicative potential (telomerase reactivation → telomere maintenance/lengthening), sustained angiogenesis (↑VEGF or ↓inhibitory factors; neoangiogenesis vs bone-marrow vasculogenesis; leaky/dilated vessels), Warburg effect (glycolysis even under aerobic conditions; pyruvate kinase M2, LDH-A; biosynthetic intermediates; ↑ lactate), immune evasion in cancer (↓ MHC class I; TGF-β + regulatory T cells; checkpoint upregulation), tissue invasion (E-cadherin loss → metalloproteinases → laminin/fibronectin → locomotion → vascular dissemination), metastasis (lymphatics/blood → endothelial adhesion → extravasation/homing; first-encountered capillary bed; lung → adrenals tropism).
